Name: STF - Pierre Shop Overhaul
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][b][size=4]STF - Pierre Shop Overhaul[/size][/b][/center]
[center]
It’s an overhaul of Pierre’s General Store progression, rebalancing item unlock conditions and levels, adjusting discount mechanics, prices, and stock quantities across multiple goods, each with its own unlock conditions, to create a more dynamic and structured economy experience.
This version still supports [b]Shop Tile Framework[/b], but it is considered deprecated due to new mechanics introduced in Stardew Valley 1.6. Future game updates may cause compatibility issues, and upcoming versions of this mod may no longer rely on STF.
This release includes multiple added items with individualized unlock conditions, alongside ongoing balance improvements and minor refinements that are still in development.
This version is intended as a foundation for a future transition to [b]Content Patcher-based implementation[/b] of the shop system. Feedback, suggestions, and contributions are highly welcome.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10563/10563-1641591399-50715774.jpeg[/img][line]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]I've added all the products related to Pierre, including:

New seeds he didn't sell before[/size]
[size=4]Farm products with a special condition to be able to buy them
Necessary items he should sell
Farming-related items
And much more in this complete overhaul of Pierre's shop products

Everything added in a way that doesn't break the game's immersion and maintains a balanced economy.

Swipe through the products and see what can be bought now!

For more suggestions, feel free to use the comments section and if you're comfortable, start a discussion.[/size][/color][/center]
